title: Enforcement of code by other than compulsory means.
officialText: Nothing in this code shall prevent the commissioner from making efforts to obtain voluntary compliance by way of warning, notice or educational means. However, such noncompulsory methods need not be used before proceeding by way of compulsory enforcement.
